message: The default CLI now writes a jev-screen success commit status to GitHub as optomachina on every accepted screen. It is not a required check (branch protection requires ci and provider-go-live only, and qa-handoff gate.mjs counts only required checks), but any all-green helper over commit statuses, including the OVD-845 gate, must exclude jev-screen.
The #743 duplicate came from screen.py, which does not read or write the marker, so dedupe across both callers (issue fix item 1) holds only after screen.py is retired; tracked as OVD-940.

When an injected marker writer throws or returns a free-text reason, the warning echoes it after sanitizeToken, which redacts only TYPESAFE_API_KEY (probe P5). The real GitHub writer returns fixed reason codes, so no token reaches logs today; keep reasons to fixed codes.

This head edits governance config: docs/sensitive-paths.json adds scripts/lib/jev-screen-marker* as infra_ci, mirrored in AGENTS.md:71 and pinned in scripts/lib/sensitive-paths.test.mjs. That is a tightening: findGateLoosening(base to head) reports detected=false, and the only loosening flag the sensitive-paths report raises is matcher_changed for the scripts/jev-pr-screen.mjs edit, which needs the Grok Bot countersign plus Blaine's card.
